tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: cinema-black
tokens.usage: Cinema Black (#0c0c0c): Deep theatrical darkness, screening room ambiance. Used as background on `body`; text on `.logo-icon`, `.status-badge`, `.film-action:hover, .film-action:focus-visible`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: screen-white
tokens.usage: Screen White (#fafafa): Projection surface purity, high-key lighting. Used as text on `body`, `.logo-title`, `.page-title`. 18.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: film-gold
tokens.usage: Film Gold (#c9a227): Oscar prestige, golden hour warmth, awards season. Used as text on `.nav-link:hover, .nav-link:focus-visible`, `.nav-link.active`, `.stat-value`. 8.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: red-carpet
tokens.usage: Red Carpet (#9f1239): Premiere glamour, dramatic accents, spotlight moments. Used as text on `.stat-change.negative`. 2.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
